thread:
maya: handing over primary for the P1 incident to @sam — I'm heading offline for the night in 10m. quick summary below, please ack and take over the pager. :rotating_light:

incident-bot: P1 triggered at 2026-03-14T18:07:12Z — high error rate (429/503) and tail latency increase on embeddings service in eu-west-1.

maya: impact: several Dedicated customers seeing 429s during bursts; hosted API degraded for long-seq embeddings jobs. support ticket count up +6 in last 15m.

maya: current mitigation steps in-flight:
- scaled autoscale group x2 for eu-west embedding pool (manual)
- disabled aggressive batching profile (temp revert to low-batch)
- applied prefix-KV cache bypass for large payloads

maya: runbooks and quick pointers:
- runbook: https://confluence.internal/runbooks/embeddings-throttle (start at "Mitigation -> Temporary rollbacks")
- quick check metrics: `curl -s https://metrics.internal/embeddings/eu-west | jq .p95`
- can validate node health: `ssh onboard@gpu-01-eu && systemctl status redwood-inference`

maya: observed logs (snip):
```
2026-03-14T17:55:02Z [WARN] batching: dropped request queue_length=124 thresh=100
2026-03-14T17:56:11Z [ERROR] kv-cache: miss_rate=0.92 keys=1024
2026-03-14T17:57:03Z [ERROR] http: upstream 503 embed-service-1
```

sam: ack. taking primary. thanks for context @maya. linking to the active incident channel for visibility. I'll keep this thread as handoff notes.

sam: immediate plan: confirm autoscale applied and watch p95/p99 for 10m, revert batching back if we see cost spike but error rate down. I'll also put fallback to smaller model variant if CPU utilization >85% on GPU nodes.

sam: can @drew and @kevin confirm there is no infra change in the last hour that could have triggered this? I see a kubecontrol restart in eu-west at 17:40 but not sure related.

drew: I saw the kubecontrol restart — that was a rolling config push to LB healthcheck params at 17:38 (not supposed to touch inference pools). digging into kube events now.

kevin: no infra deploys to the inference ASG. autoscale policy was modified last week but unchanged today. looking at kernel dev metrics for OOMs.

sam: support update: @talia, can you confirm customer-impacted list and any SLA escalations?

talia (support-lead): confirmed 3 Dedicated customers with intermittent 429s (IDs: C-7721, C-8803, C-9912). Raised INC-3492 for the external incident; notified account teams. They requested ETA for fix — will give rolling updates every 30m.

sam: created internal task: P-8401 cover autoscale policy review and fallback routing (assigned to @kevin). link: https://jira.internal/browse/P-8401

sam: action: schedule a short retro tomorrow 09:30 PT to capture root cause and runbook gaps — created RETRO-3492 (calendar invite sent to oncall, platform, support).

maya: coverage note: we don't currently have a secondary oncall in APAC overnight (coverage gap). filing a follow-up ticket to adjust rotation overlap windows.

sam: filing follow-up ticket now -> OPS-2105 (adjust oncall rotations + add documented warm-handoff checklist).

sam: immediate mitigations I executed:
```
- confirmed ASG scale up x2 (aws autoscaling describe-auto-scaling-groups --group-name eu-embed-pool)
- set model fallback route: embed-v2 -> embed-v1 for long sequences
- bumped healthcheck threshold to reduce flapping
```

sam: monitoring for next 20m. if error rate drops under 1% and p95 < 250ms we can start rolling back temporary changes and document exact timestamps.

drew: found spike in kv-lock wait times correlating with node GC at 17:54 — attaching logs to INC-3492. suspect cache eviction policy + a particular customer pattern triggering mass misses.

kevin: I'll run a quick canary of a different quantized model on a spare node to verify throughput improvement. command I'll use: `kubectl -n inference exec -it canary-01 -- /usr/local/bin/run_canary --model embed-q4`

talia: customer comms: prepared a status note to send in 15m with impact summary and mitigation steps.

sam: action items captured (short):
- kevin: P-8401 adjust autoscale / implement graceful scale down (owner: kevin)
- drew: debug kv eviction pattern + add telemetry (owner: drew)
- maya: document handoff notes and add to RETRO-3492 (owner: maya)
- talia: continue customer comms cadence (owner: talia)
- sam: verify model fallback behavior and timeline for rollback (owner: sam)

sam: coverage gap ticket OPS-2105 created for rotation overlap. assigning to oncall lead for schedule change.

maya: leaving now — @sam has primary. ping me if you need any context, I'll respond within 1h if urgent. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
